reviews_h2: What people are saying about the plumbing

reviews.author: Steve Appleton
reviews.text: Great customer service. Called and had to leave a message. I got a call back the next day and service was scheduled for the following day. The guys that came called when they were on their way, were very knowledgeable, professional, and accommodating. When they worked up my invoice, I was pleasantly surprised and thought the price I paid very fair. So if there isn't poop in your tub or you don't have some other plumbing emergency that you need someone right away, then these guys are great.

reviews.author: Marlene McDade
reviews.text: After an exhausting search to find a plumber I was happy to get a call from ACME. They showed when promised, got it done, and were out in 45 minutes. He also gave me tips on how to avoid the problem in the future. Friendly and knowledgeable - I will definitely use them in the future!

reviews.author: Travis McCarn
reviews.text: I will definitely use ACME Plumbing again. I rec’d a quick call back after leaving a message. Bradley came out the same day and was able to fix my water heater less than 30 minutes. Cost was very minimal and I was very satisfied with the great service!

reviews.author: Charles
reviews.text: Called them to repair a leaking drain in the crawl space. Keith arrived right on time, assessed the problem and completed the repair in under an hour. Cost was very reasonable. These folks are busy, as professionals usually are. Patience is a virtue. These people are great.

reviews.author: Linda Randolph
reviews.text: He was 1.5 hrs late, here 10 mins. Had to get parts to replace in tank of commode, said he would be here between 8 - 9am on Fri. a.m. I waited all day, they didn't show up finally called me at 4:40pm to say it would cost $275.00. This is outrageous pricing. They are out to rip off single elderly people. Do not use them unless you have lots of money.

reviews.author: HollyC
reviews.text: Called a bunch of people. Acme was the only one who returned my call. He came out same day, fixed it and got the water back on in no time. Thought the price was very reasonable especially considering we are out of town. Professional and friendly. Thank-you!

reviews.author: Vanessa Kuzmanovski
reviews.text: Keith returned my call promptly and worked with me to help me get my problem fixed for the time being and even walked me through what needs to be done to replace the clay piping and get a big job taken care of!! He is not scared of jobs big or small! Great place, friendly. I truly recommend! Thank you!

reviews.author: Dennis Bronson
reviews.text: Had a back up in the sewage line. ACME Plumbing came out within 2 hours and got the issue resolved quickly. Price was very reasonable, recommend using them .

reviews.author: vicki comer
reviews.text: Acme Plumbing is our plumber at my business. They have always done an excellent job. They really do take care of us & are always there for us when we need them. Thanks Keith & Bradley!

reviews.author: Joey McCoy
reviews.text: A father and son team that gets the job done. Arrived at my house, diagnosed the problem and fixed it better than it was when I bought the house 8 years ago. They are my go-to for plumbing from now on.

reviews.author: Frank Broadway
reviews.text: I have had L&R repair the transmission on two vehicles. Each time they have been professional and fair with their pricing.
